label: Skew from a length mismatch
subgoals: Convert mils to inches before multiplying
Multiply the length difference by the delay per inch
Correct mismatch close to where it arises

label: Length tolerance from a budget
subgoals: Compute the layer's delay per inch from its Dk
Divide the skew budget by the delay per inch
Round the tolerance down so the budget holds

label: Matching a group to a strobe
section: Matching a group to a strobe
subgoals: Compute each member's delay relative to the strobe
Count members outside the matching window
Add serpentines with enough spacing to avoid self-coupling
